srp_violations.description: Manages dungeon generation algorithm, ghost object pooling, loop detection, AND SAT collision overlap testing all in a single 600-line class.
srp_violations.evidence: Methods: Generate, TryPlaceRoom, TryPlaceLoop, TryBridgeRoom, CheckForNaturalLoop, IsOverlapping, PolygonsOverlap, AlignRooms, SetupGhostPool, GetWeightedRandomRoom — 10+ distinct sub-responsibilities.

srp_violations.description: Combines editor tooling (Odin buttons, AssetDatabase), async DFS loop search, room pooling, and SAT polygon overlap — all duplicating code from DungeonGenerator.
srp_violations.evidence: AlignRooms, PolygonsOverlap, Project, GetWorldFootprint are exact copies of DungeonGenerator methods. Also mixes async/await with Unity editor callbacks.

srp_violations.description: Manages session state machine, NGO scene loading/unloading, scene event routing, player teleport orchestration, and ready-gate interaction.
srp_violations.evidence: OnSceneEvent switch handles 4 flow steps; HandleReturnTeleports directly queries elevatorGate and splits players into lists.

srp_violations.description: Handles Steam voice capture, network relay (server role), decompression, speaker lookup, and distance culling in one MonoBehaviour.
srp_violations.evidence: OnVoiceFromClient (server relay) and OnVoiceFromServer (client decode) are distinct concerns folded into one class with separate memory buffers.

srp_violations.description: Combines NavMesh movement driving, ragdoll death sequence, and input bridging between NavMeshAgent and CharacterMovement.
srp_violations.evidence: Ragdoll coroutine directly disables CharacterController, CharacterMovement, Health — mixes locomotion and death responsibilities.

srp_violations.description: Handles physics ragdoll activation, per-bone rigidbody control, AND player grab interaction (ISimpleInteractable) including applying drag weight to the grabber's camera and movement.
srp_violations.evidence: StartInteract reaches into grabber's CharacterMovement and FirstPersonCamera via GetComponent — strong coupling across systems.

srp_violations.description: Acts as service locator and also owns netcode event subscription / state transition.
srp_violations.evidence: Exposes Instance (singleton), Config, PlayerRegistry, IdentityProvider — many unrelated consumers depend on this one class.

code_smells.description: AlignRooms, IsOverlapping, PolygonsOverlap, Project, and GetWorldFootprint are copy-pasted verbatim between DungeonGenerator and LoopPregenerator.
code_smells.suggestion: Extract a static DungeonGeometryUtils class (or ProceduralGenerationUtils) with these shared methods.

code_smells.description: RagdollController.StartInteract reaches into the grabber Transform and calls SetSlowingWeight on CharacterMovement and FirstPersonCamera, directly coupling AI death to player camera/movement internals.
code_smells.suggestion: Introduce an ISlowable interface or broadcast a physics drag event rather than coupling via direct GetComponent calls.

code_smells.description: Two parallel interaction systems exist: the legacy ISimpleInteractable (SimplePlayerInteractor, RagdollController) and the production IInteractable + InteractionContext system. Both are active in the codebase.
code_smells.suggestion: Migrate RagdollController and any remaining ISimpleInteractable consumers to IInteractable, then delete ISimpleInteractable.

code_smells.description: CharacterMovement, FirstPersonCamera, PlayerInputHandler, and SimplePlayerInteractor have no namespace. Other systems use HuntGame.Player, HuntingGame, DungeonSteakhouse.Net etc.
code_smells.suggestion: Move root-namespace classes into HuntGame.Player or HuntGame.Core.

code_smells.description: Health.ChangeHealth has a bug: the else branch increments `healthPoint` (SerializeField max value) instead of `currentHealthPoint`.
NetGameRoot.Instance, NetSessionManager.Instance, and SteamBootstrap.Ready/ReadyChanged are static singletons. Any class can call them without injection, making testing and scene isolation harder.
code_smells.suggestion: Keep singletons but inject dependencies via inspector where practical (NetSessionManager is already injected on ElevatorEffectsController).

code_smells.description: ElevatorEffectsController.CameraShakeRoutine uses Camera.main directly, which returns null in multiplayer additive scenes when NetLocalCameraEnforcer has not finished enforcing.
code_smells.suggestion: Resolve camera via NetLocalCameraEnforcer or inject it explicitly.

code_smells.description: NetcodeInteractableObject.RequestInteractServerRpc allocates a NativeArray with Allocator.Persistent and disposes it after SendClientRpc. If an exception occurs between allocation and Dispose, memory leaks.
code_smells.suggestion: Use a try/finally block around the Dispose call, or switch to Allocator.Temp if NGO reads it synchronously.

refactoring_suggestions.title: Fix Health.ChangeHealth bug
refactoring_suggestions.description: Line `healthPoint += value` must be `currentHealthPoint += value`. The current code modifies the inspector-set max value instead of current HP, causing health not to decrease correctly.

refactoring_suggestions.title: Extract DungeonGeometryUtils shared utility
refactoring_suggestions.description: Move AlignRooms, IsOverlapping, PolygonsOverlap, Project, and GetWorldFootprint into a static or non-MonoBehaviour utility class. Both DungeonGenerator and LoopPregenerator reference it. Eliminates ~120 lines of duplicated code.

refactoring_suggestions.title: Migrate ISimpleInteractable to IInteractable
refactoring_suggestions.description: RagdollController implements ISimpleInteractable (legacy). Convert it to IInteractable with InteractionContext. Delete ISimpleInteractable and SimplePlayerInteractor once migration is complete. This unifies the interaction pipeline.

refactoring_suggestions.title: Introduce ISlowable to decouple RagdollController grab
refactoring_suggestions.description: RagdollController.StartInteract/EndInteract directly calls CharacterMovement.SetSlowingWeight and FirstPersonCamera.SetSlowingWeight. Extract interface ISlowable { void SetSlowingWeight(bool, float); } and implement on both. RagdollController only knows ISlowable.

refactoring_suggestions.title: Split DungeonGenerator into focused classes
refactoring_suggestions.description: Separate responsibilities: DungeonGhostPool (ghost object lifecycle), DungeonRoomPlacer (TryPlaceRoom, AlignRooms), DungeonLoopPlacer (TryPlaceLoop, TryBridgeRoom), DungeonOverlapTester (SAT polygon math). DungeonGenerator becomes an orchestrator.

refactoring_suggestions.title: Add namespace to root-level player scripts
refactoring_suggestions.description: Move CharacterMovement, FirstPersonCamera, PlayerInputHandler, SimplePlayerInteractor to namespace HuntGame.Player. Consistent with HeadBobbing and PlayerHeadIK.

refactoring_suggestions.title: Wrap NativeArray disposal in try/finally in NetcodeInteractableObject
refactoring_suggestions.description: RequestInteractServerRpc allocates NativeArray(Persistent). Wrap Dispose in try/finally to prevent leaks on exception paths.

refactoring_suggestions.title: Fix ElevatorEffectsController camera resolution
refactoring_suggestions.description: Replace Camera.main lookup in CameraShakeRoutine with an injected camera reference or query via NetLocalCameraEnforcer. Camera.main is unreliable in additive multiplayer scenes.
